description: This Java class 'LogFragment' defines an Android Fragment that displays a log view, allowing for output of log data through a LogNode interface. It manages UI components such as a ScrollView containing a custom LogView, setting styles, padding, and handling text change events to auto-scroll.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that encapsulates a log display view, typically used for debugging or logging output within an app.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and inflates the view hierarchy including a ScrollView containing a custom LogView, setting layout parameters and styles.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment’s method to further set up the LogView, including adding a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new text.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the instance of the LogView contained within this fragment for external access.
